title: Time Will Tell: Harness Time to Denoise Collaborative Filtering
abstract: arXiv:2411.09181v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural graph collaborative filtering is a powerful tool for recommendation due to its superb capability of capturing the user-item interaction. Despite the substantial progress, the noisy nature of interaction data remains a significant challenge in collaborative filtering, especially for data collected from implicit feedback. Both noisy interactions and interactions crafted by malicious users could greatly degenerate model performance. To purify the input data and enhance model robustness, it is vital to understand how noisy interactions can be identified and rectified. Existing denoising methods focus on mining the correlation between user/item embeddings and noisy interactions, neglecting the temporal dimension for denoising. However, time information bears its natural and unique advantage in revealing noisy edges as we observe in this paper. translated_title: 时间会证明：利用时间信息为协同过滤去噪
translated_abstract: 神经图协同过滤凭借其捕捉用户-物品交互的卓越能力，成为一种强大的推荐工具。尽管已取得长足进展，交互数据固有的噪声特性仍然是协同过滤中的重大挑战，对于从隐式反馈中收集的数据尤其如此。噪声交互和恶意用户蓄意构造的交互都会严重损害模型性能。为了净化输入数据并增强模型鲁棒性，理解如何识别并纠正噪声交互至关重要。现有的去噪方法侧重于挖掘用户/物品嵌入与噪声交互之间的相关性，而忽视了去噪中的时间维度。然而，正如本文所观察到的，时间信息在揭示噪声边方面具有其天然且独特的优势。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种简单而有效的机制来生成时间感知（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出一种简单而有效的时间感知去噪机制，利用交互的时间信息来识别并纠正协同过滤中的噪声交互，从而提升推荐模型的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a simple yet effective time-aware mechanism that leverages temporal information of interactions to identify and rectify noisy edges in collaborative filtering, thereby improving recommendation robustness.
